title: pancreatic_cancer_SVM
summary: An SVM-based classifier for predicting pancreatic cancer risk from impedance measurements of four biomarker proteins. To address class imbalance, synthetic_data_ca125.py fits SDV's CTGANSynthesizer on real patient data via SingleTableMetadata to generate additional minority-class samples.
evidence: files/synthetic_data_ca125.py:5-9: CTGANSynthesizer(metadata, epochs=300, batch_size=512); synth.fit(real_data); n_minority = 1000
